title: euphrasia officinalis var. hirtella
intro: Euphrasia officinalis var. hirtella, commonly known as Hairy Eyebright, is a variety of the Eyebright plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant has been used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating eye and ear infections, as well as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hairy Eyebright include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating a range of conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
